message.content:
Sure! To retrieve only the **IDs** and **context attributes** for the CAA records of `sample2.com` (and nothing else), you can use the **list** endpoint with a few query parameters that narrow down the response.

---

## 1️⃣ Endpoint

```
GET https://api.example.com/v1/domains/sample2.com/caa_records
```

> Replace `https://api.example.com` with the actual base URL of your DNS‑API provider.

---

## 2️⃣ Required Header

| Header | Value |
|--------|-------|
| `Authorization` | `Bearer secret567` |

> Use your API key (`secret567`) as a bearer token. No other authentication headers are needed.

---

## 3️⃣ Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `$select` | string | – | Comma‑separated list of fields to return. Set to `id,context` to get only those two fields. |
| `$filter` | string | – | Optional filter expression. Not needed for this request. |
| `$top` | integer | – | Optional limit on number of records returned. You can set it to a small number if you expect many records. |
| `$skip` | integer | – | Optional offset for pagination. |
| `$count` | boolean | – | Optional flag to include total count. |

### Example Request

```http
GET https://api.example.com/v1/domains/sample2.com/caa_records?$select=id,context HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer secret567
Accept: application/json
```

---

## 4️⃣ Expected Response

```json
{
  "value": [
    {
      "id": "caa-12345",
      "context": {
        "tag": "issue",
        "value": "letsencrypt.org"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "caa-67890",
      "context": {
        "tag": "iodef",
        "value": "mailto:security@example.com"
      }
    }
  ],
  "@odata.count": 2   // Only present if you set `$count=true`
}
```

> The response will contain an array named `value`. Each element will have only the `id` and `context` fields, exactly what you asked for.

---

## 5️⃣ Pagination (if needed)

If the domain has many CAA records, the API may paginate the results:

```http
GET https://api.example.com/v1/domains/sample2.com/caa_records?$select=id,context&$top=50&$skip=50
```

> Continue increasing `$skip` until the returned `value` array is empty.

---

## 6️⃣ Quick Checklist

- ✅ Use the correct domain path (`sample2.com`).
- ✅ Include the `Authorization` header with your API key.
- ✅ Add `$select=id,context` to the query string.
- ✅ Optionally add `$top` and `$skip` for pagination.
- ✅ Inspect the `value` array in the JSON response; it should contain only `id` and `context`.

That’s all you need! If you hit any errors or need help interpreting the response, let me know.
